statement: CREATE TRIGGER `step13_d1`.`s13_d1_d16cf6bd` BEFORE INSERT ON `sales_order_item` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN IF NEW.product_id IN (1,56) THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MYSQL_ERRNO=1644,MESSAGE_TEXT='STEP13_D1_1e5098ebee94'; END IF; END

CREATE TRIGGER `step13_d2`.`s13_d2_b4f35ce6` BEFORE UPDATE ON `product` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN IF OLD.id=56 AND NEW.stock<OLD.stock THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MYSQL_ERRNO=1644,MESSAGE_TEXT='STEP13_D2_8b658ca42571'; END IF; END

CREATE TRIGGER `step13_d3`.`s13_d3_19045399` BEFORE DELETE ON `cart_item` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN IF OLD.id=17 AND OLD.user_id=1 THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MYSQL_ERRNO=1644,MESSAGE_TEXT='STEP13_D3_e7a67b037076'; END IF; END

CREATE TRIGGER `step13_d4`.`s13_d4_fb147874` BEFORE UPDATE ON `product` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN IF OLD.id=56 AND NEW.stock>OLD.stock THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MYSQL_ERRNO=1644,MESSAGE_TEXT='STEP13_D4_cbb8ff1d9ceb'; END IF; END

CREATE TRIGGER `step13_d5`.`s13_d5_6470a907` BEFORE UPDATE ON `sales_order` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN IF OLD.id=16 AND OLD.status='PENDING_PAYMENT' AND NEW.status='PAID' THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MYSQL_ERRNO=1644,MESSAGE_TEXT='STEP13_D5_069e766ef70f'; END IF; END
